Example 4.1 illustrates that the locally optimal strategy may not be unique even if there is no redundancy among the traded assets. Example 4.2 contrasts classical mean-variance and monotone mean variance optimal portfolios in a continuous-time setting: Example 4.3 shows that the equivalences in Theorem 2.25 fail when R is not square integrable.
